bitshuffle-transpose.description: Bitshuffle 0.5.2 bshuf_bitshuffle (commit 52aec3b80d05606c090956aecfe868489d96b95c, MIT, gcc -O3 -march=native -fPIC, compile-time AVX2 route); fixed cells transform 64 eight-byte elements into a preallocated output, adapter cells pad/pack/unpack around one block into a fresh canonical output

gf2-transpose.description: gf2 transpose: fixed cells call the runtime-dispatched 64x64 kernel (gf2_kernels_simd::transpose::detect), consumer cells call BitMatrix::transpose with a fresh output; x86-64 baseline build, kernel selected at run time and reported by the child; warm cells make one untimed pass before calibration

m4ri-transpose.description: M4RI 20260122 mzd_transpose (release tarball, GPL-2.0-or-later, gcc -O3 -march=native -fPIC, no runtime dispatch); fixed cells reuse a preallocated output, consumer cells allocate a fresh one
